prior_findings.title: First save destroys opaque metadata on imported condition expressions
evidence: applyConnectionProperties now reuses semantic.conditionExpression whenever its moddle type matches, mutating only body, language, and evaluatesToTypeRef before assigning the same object back at src/core/BpmnDocument.ts:845-861.
The focused regression 'preserves opaque metadata on an imported formal condition during updates' passed and asserts expression ID plus vendor extension retention.
Manual import -> autosave -> unrelated update -> save -> loadDiagram -> export replay preserved id Expr_1, documentation 'keep me', vendor:metadata flag='yes', and body 'amount > 0'.

prior_findings.title: Alias precedence persists a different default-flow decision than the request expresses
evidence: BpmnConnectOptions and the connect handler now expose and forward only isDefault; the undocumented default/defaultFlow connect aliases and their nullish precedence chain are gone (src/types/index.ts:104-109, src/server/handlers.ts:359-376).

Default reassignment/clearing is now a single typed top-level BpmnElementUpdate.defaultFlow field, and updateElement uses presence-based detection so explicit null clears rather than falling through to another alias (src/types/index.ts:111-116, src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:377-409).

The focused public-handler condition/default test passed, including top-level defaultFlow:null clearing in persisted XML; a manual canonical isDefault create followed by top-level null clear also exported with source.default undefined.
